enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +5 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.

Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Insightful Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Radiance +47: Passive: +47 Insight bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Insightful Radiance Lore +9: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 9% Insight bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Coalesced Flame: Whenever you cast a Fire or Light spell, you gain +50 Temporary Spell Points that last for 30 seconds. This can only trigger once every 45 seconds.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
